title: Block Smile
short_description: Classic block-stacking puzzle. Clear lines, beat your high score!
full_description:
Block Smile — a legendary block-stacking puzzle, polished for today.

★ AUTHENTIC BLOCK PUZZLE
7 classic block shapes. Rotate, slide, drop. Clear lines to score. Speed up as you level up. Survive as long as you can.

★ MODES
• Marathon — endless levels, classic block puzzle
• Sprint — clear 40 lines as fast as possible
• Ultra — score as much as you can in 2 minutes
• Zen — no game over, pure relaxation

★ FEATURES
• Hold piece, ghost piece, next-7 preview
• Combo and back-to-back bonuses
• 8 achievements
• Global leaderboard
• Daily challenge
• Multiple themes (classic, neon, minimal)
• Plays offline

★ COMPETITIVE
Climb the leaderboard. Beat your friends' high scores via Play Games Services.

★ FAIR ADS
Optional. Remove forever with one purchase.

Block Smile — un joc legendar de puzzle cu blocuri, modernizat pentru astazi.

★ PUZZLE CLASIC CU BLOCURI
7 forme clasice de blocuri. Roteste, gliseaza, da drumul. Curata linii pentru scor. Acceleraza pe masura ce avansezi. Supravietuieste cat poti.

★ MODURI
• Maraton — niveluri infinite
• Sprint — curata 40 linii cat mai rapid
• Ultra — fa scor maxim in 2 minute
• Zen — relaxare pura, fara game over

★ CARACTERISTICI
• Hold piece, ghost piece, next-7 preview
• Combo si back-to-back bonuses
• 8 realizari
• Clasament global
• Provocare zilnica
• Multiple teme (classic, neon, minimal)
• Functioneaza offline

★ COMPETITIV
Urca in clasament. Bate scorurile prietenilor via Play Games Services.
